R1: Walk me through how you would diagnose and improve customer satisfaction. Our NPS is 30, and we want to increase it to 50.
Our support team receives 50,000 tickets per month with 48-hour resolution time. Industry best is 24 hours. How would you improve?
Design a customer support operating model. What channels would you offer? How would you route inquiries? What SLAs?
We're seeing a 25% increase in WISMO tickets month-over-month. How would you reduce these through product improvements?
Build a customer segmentation strategy for support. Should you provide differentiated service for high-value customers?
Our CSAT is 75% but varies by issue type: delivery (60%), payment (70%), returns (80%), product questions (85%). How would you prioritize?
Design a self-service support system to reduce ticket volume. What deflection rate would you target?
We're expanding to 10 new cities. How would you scale support operations? Outsource, in-house, or hybrid?
Build a quality monitoring framework for customer support. What metrics would you track?
Our chat support has 5-minute wait time and 30% abandonment. How would you reduce wait times?
Design a voice of customer (VoC) program to systematically collect and act on feedback.
Delivery partners are calling customers multiple times for address clarification. How would you solve this root cause?
Build a customer escalation framework. What defines critical? What SLAs? Who gets involved?
Our return and refund policy is causing confusion. Should you simplify from multiple return windows?
Design a proactive customer support strategy instead of reactive.
Build a customer education program to reduce support tickets.
Our support team morale is low. What initiatives would you implement?
Design a customer complaint resolution framework for serious issues.
We're getting negative reviews on social media about customer service. How would you respond?
Build a forecasting model for support volume including spikes during sales events.
R2: Case: CSAT Crisis - Satisfaction dropped from 80% to 65%. You have 90 days to turn it around.
Case: Fraud vs. Genuine Customer - Customer claims non-delivery of ₹5 lakhs worth of smartphones. Delivery confirms delivery. How do you resolve?
Case: Product Quality Crisis - 500 complaints in 24 hours about defective products posing safety risk. What's your response?
Case: Support Outsourcing Decision - A BPO offers 40% lower cost. Should you outsource?
Case: Multilingual Support - Expanding to regions with Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Marathi speakers. How to provide cost-effective support?
Case: Return Abuse - Some customers are 'wardrobing' (using and returning). Returns costing 8% of revenue.
Case: Peak Season Preparedness - Last year support volume spiked 5x and CSAT dropped to 50%. How to prepare?
Case: Negative Viral Post - A complaint video has 1 million views. How do you handle this PR crisis?
Case: Support Channel Optimization - Phone costs ₹150/ticket, email ₹50, chat ₹40, chatbot ₹5. How to shift volume?
Case: Agent Attrition - 40% annual attrition disrupting quality. What retention initiatives?
Case: Compensation Budget - Exceeding ₹50 lakhs monthly budget by 30%. How to balance satisfaction with cost?
Case: Data Privacy Incident - Customer received another customer's order with personal info visible. What's your response?
Case: Support Ticket Categorization - Build a taxonomy to classify 50,000 monthly tickets.
Case: Chatbot vs. Human - What queries should be automated vs. handled by humans?
Case: Cross-Functional Alignment - 30% of tickets are caused by preventable issues. How to fix root causes?
